 Talking points this week: What has happened at Shakhtar Donetsk and Sporting CP?
 Shakhtar have won three, drawn one and lost one of their last five competitive matches. Most recently, they beat Obolon Kyiv 2-0 in the Ukrainian Premier League. Their only setback was a 1-0 Champions League defeat to Inter Milan. Across those five matches, Shakhtar scored eight goals and conceded just two.
 Across their last five matches, Sporting CP have three wins and two defeats. They most recently won 2-0 away at Casa Pia in Liga Portugal. In the Champions League, however, they lost their latest match 3-2 to LASK, having previously won 2-0 away to Lens. Sporting scored seven goals and conceded seven in those five matches.
